title: USGS Southeast SPARROW references for the original five Upper Savannah calibration reaches

source_bindings.rationale: Original published SPARROW regional calibration reach bound to the full retained current NLDI feature; select actual prediction COMID_ORIG. Original regional 2012-reference annual target within source-global WY2000–2014 horizon. Individual station sampling windows and target standard errors are not exposed. Compare native scenario vintages explicitly; preserve current full-reach NLDI catchment edition and original source constituent.
